preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of threads is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi, xi, ci in threads)
preconditions.description: Each thread connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 + 6 for ui, vi, xi, ci in threads)
preconditions.description: The clamminess of each thread is between 1 and 10^9 + 6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(ci in {0, 1} for ui, vi, xi, ci in threads)
preconditions.description: Each thread is either red (0) or black (1).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The output is within the range 0 to 10^9 + 6 inclusive.
The output is 1 if no valid paths exist, otherwise it is the product of clamminess values of all valid paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
